subject: PO metadata, invoice-slice flow, and conditional discount trigger
messages:
From: Amelia White <amelia.white@goldleafhealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@goldleafhealth.com>
Date: 2027-08-23T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Invoice cadence & PO requirements for Goldleaf pilot

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. Procurement had a couple of gating items before we can activate the pilot PO:

- PO must include our internal project code (GLH-PLT-09) in the invoice reference line.
- We need invoices on a weekly sampling cadence for the first two months (weekly statement) before switching to monthly consolidated invoices.
- Net terms: our finance team prefers Net45 but will accept Net30 for vendors that meet 2% early-pay discount if invoices are submitted as consolidated weekly batches flagged with an "acceptance code".
- PO must be issued to the vendor legal name and include vendor tax ID (we can provide a template).

Can you confirm Redwood can:
1) put a dedicated PO field in the invoice (GLH-PLT-09) and include an acceptance code string,
2) support weekly sampling invoices for 8 weeks,
3) show the early-pay discount conditions in writing (what triggers the 2%)?

Attached is our internal onboarding checklist and a sample PO format (pdf). If possible, we'd like to close procurement gating items by next Thursday so AP can schedule the first payment run.

Thanks,
Amelia White
Senior Procurement Manager
Goldleaf Health
Attachments: goldleaf_onboarding_checklist.pdf
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia White <amelia.white@goldleafhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-23T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice cadence & PO requirements for Goldleaf pilot

Hi Amelia,

Appreciate the clear list — this is doable, and I want to outline the operational bits so your AP has no surprises. Summary of what we can commit to today: 

- PO metadata: we will populate the invoice's "Order Reference" field with GLH-PLT-09 and include a separate header for your acceptance code. We'll return a Redwood_PO_Template.xlsx (attached) prefilled with the fields your ERP expects (PO number, GLH project code, tax ID).

- Weekly sampling / transition: we can run weekly sampling invoices for the first 8 weeks. Each weekly invoice will be itemized; at week 9 we can emit a consolidated monthly statement if you want.

- Early-pay discount: Redwood can offer a 2% early-pay discount if Goldleaf pays the consolidated weekly batch within 10 calendar days of invoice receipt AND the invoice is submitted with the specified acceptance code in the header. We will include a discount flag on the invoice export for your AP automation to pick up.

Operational notes / exceptions: 
- If invoices need to be split across multiple legal entities, please confirm entity mapping — our billing system requires entity-level PO fields; mis-mapping delays payment.
- For Net30 vs Net45: we bill Net30 by default. If Goldleaf requires Net45 but wants the 2% early-pay discount, we can implement Net45 with a contractual addendum that documents the early-pay logic (discount applies for payment within 10 days of invoice receipt).

I have cc'd Ben (pricing) and Tessa (billing ops) so they can confirm ED-level discount language and the acceptance-code mechanics. Attaching the Redwood_PO_Template.xlsx and a short Invoice_Sampling_Proposal.pdf that shows how weekly vs monthly will look in your ERP.

Next steps: if you confirm entity mapping and acceptance-code format by EOD Wednesday, Tessa will prepare the sample invoices for your AP to test.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_PO_Template.xlsx, Invoice_Sampling_Proposal.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Amelia White <amelia.white@goldleafhealth.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-24T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice cadence & PO requirements for Goldleaf pilot

Hi Amelia / Grace,

Quick pricing clarification from my side so procurement has the exact contract language:

- Discount trigger: the 2% early-pay discount is conditional on three things being met on each consolidated weekly batch: (1) Invoice contains the GLH-PLT-09 reference; (2) Acceptance code matches the one routed to Redwood (we will generate a per-PO acceptance code and send it to your AP via encrypted email); (3) Payment is received within 10 calendar days of invoice receipt.

- If Goldleaf requires Net45 as invoice terms, we will document Net45 in the SOW but preserve the early-pay 2% clause with the same 10-day payment window for discount calculation. That way AR sees Net45 as the default ledger term while allowing AP to take the discount if they pay earlier.

- For milestone or usage spikes: if a weekly sampling invoice exceeds the pre-agreed weekly cap (we'll list caps per SKU in the PO), Redwood will flag the invoice as "exception" and the early-pay discount will not apply until the exception is resolved. This protects unit economics for Redwood on burst usage.

I will draft a short addendum paragraph for the contract that Tessa can drop into the SOW. Naomi, can you confirm the acceptance-code generation pipeline and the encryption method for sharing codes with Goldleaf AP?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Amelia White <amelia.white@goldleafhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@goldleafhealth.com>, AP Team <invoices@goldleafhealth.com>
Date: 2027-08-24T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice cadence & PO requirements for Goldleaf pilot

Thanks Ben and Grace — that all makes sense. A couple of quick items from AP: 

1) Please include an "Acceptance Code" column in the invoice CSV export and in the PDF header; we'll add a simple regex check to our AP system to validate.
2) For exceptions: AP will route flagged exceptions back to procurement and CC your billing ops inbox (tessa.morgan@redwood.ai).
3) Entity mapping: Goldleaf will be a single legal entity for this pilot — GLH US Inc., tax ID 98-7654321 — so no multi-entity mapping needed.

We will proceed with issuing the PO once we receive the prefilled Redwood_PO_Template.xlsx and the short addendum language for the contract. Can you send a redline-ready sentence for the early-pay discount clause and the acceptance-code process by EOD tomorrow?

Appreciate the fast turnaround — I'll route to AP for a dry-run of the weekly sample once we have the template.

Best,
Amelia White
Senior Procurement Manager
Goldleaf Health
